sources.title: X adoption-boundary signal
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The X post is a community observation that some organizations may restrict use of China-origin models for policy reasons independent of technical capability or license.

limitations.text: A single X post cannot establish prevalence, sector scope, geography, or formal enterprise procurement policy.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Seek non-X enterprise policy, procurement, governance, or credible reporting that corroborates China-origin model restrictions and clearly bounds their prevalence.
targets.finding: No non-X corroboration is present in the accepted Discovery task, so the observation remains a bounded community signal and cannot support a generalized enterprise-adoption claim.
